defs: def sdl: [.assets | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("schemas/")) | .value] | join("\n"); def fields($type): sdl | [capture("type " + $type + " \\{(?<b>[^}]*)\\}").b | split("\n")[] | select(test("^\\s*[a-z_]+:")) ] ; def gate: .config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-gate");

jq.name: every scalar schema field is immutable (DefraDB refuses @immutable on a list)
jq.expr: . as $d | ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ExportRequest", "ExportReceipt"] | all(. as $t | ($d | fields($t)) as $f | ($f | length) > 0 and ($f | all(test(": \\[") or test("@immutable")))) and ([$d | fields("Claim"), fields("Entity") | map(select(test(": \\["))) | length] == [1, 1])

jq.name: the manifest declares exactly the eight schema files
the gate callback emits one receipt and four row ports correlated by batch_id
jq.expr: gate | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_gate", "gents/claim_gate")) and .correlation_field == "batch_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required: (.required // false)}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "GateReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true}, {name: "claims", collection: "Claim", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "edges", collection: "Edge", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "entities", collection: "Entity", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "perspectives", collection: "Perspective", cardinality: "many", required: false}]) and (.outputs | all(.correlation_field == "batch_id" and .schema == (.collection + "/v1")))

jq.name: every callback output collection has a schema with a batch_id field
jq.expr: . as $d | gate | .handler.outputs | all(.collection as $c | $d | fields($c) | any(test("^\\s*batch_id:")))

jq.name: the gate fires on created ClaimBatch documents and is bound to every ClaimBatch field
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "claim-batch") | .source_collection == "ClaimBatch" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "batch_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-gate") | .event_source_id == "claim-batch" and (.input_fields | sort) == ($d | fields("ClaimBatch") | map(capture("^\\s*(?<n>[a-z_]+):").n) | sort))

jq.name: the gate may only query the four graph collections and reads source_root
the export plugin may only query the four graph collections
the SME queries the graph and receipts, writes only through file_question, and may export
jq.expr: .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "claim-sme-tools") | .datastore.enable_defra_query == true and (.datastore.defra_query_collections | sort) == ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "ExportReceipt", "GateReceipt", "Perspective"] and .datastore.datastore_tool_surface_ids == ["claim-question-writes"] and (.datastore.write_collections // [] | length == 0) and (.integrations.plugins | map(.plugin)) == ["gents/claim_export"]

jq.name: the question surface creates ClaimBatch with batch_id, section and claims required
jq.expr: .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "claim-question-writes") | (.entries | if type == "object" then .entries else . end) | length == 1 and .[0].collection == "ClaimBatch" and .[0].tool_name == "file_question" and ([.[0].fields[] | select(.required == true) | .name] | sort) == ["batch_id", "claims", "section"] and ([.[0].fields[].name] | index("source_root") == null)

jq.name: the agent uses the sme slot and its context
jq.expr: (.config.agents | map({agent_id, context_id, inference_profile_id})) == [{agent_id: "claim-sme", context_id: "claim-sme-context", inference_profile_id: "gents:inference-slot:sme"}] and (.manifest.inference_slots | map({name, agents})) == [{name: "sme", agents: ["claim-sme"]}] and (.config.contexts[] | select(.context_id == "claim-sme-context") | .tools_id == "claim-sme-tools")

jq.name: the prompt names the tools and edge types it relies on
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/claim_sme/system_prompt.md"] | contains("file_question") and contains("retracts") and contains("supersedes") and contains("contradicts") and contains("entity_text")

jq.name: the import tool and the README carry no em or en dash
an ExportRequest runs claim_export as a callback with one required ExportReceipt port
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-export") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_export", "gents/claim_export")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "ExportReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "export-request") | .source_collection == "ExportRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-export") | .callback_id == "claim-export" and .event_source_id == "export-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "out_dir", "sections", "dry_run"]) and ($d | fields("ExportReceipt") | any(test("^\\s*request_id:")))
